title: Sentinel-2 L2A STAC-GeoParquet Mirror
description: Item indexes for the AWS Earth Search Sentinel-2 L2A archives, published as partitioned STAC-GeoParquet plus MGRS-tile aggregate stats, with no STAC API in front: clients query the Parquet files directly over HTTP. The primary pair, `sentinel-2-c1-l2a` with `stats-c1`, mirrors Earth Search's Sentinel-2 Collection 1 index (ESA's uniform reprocessing of the archive; 30.4 million items, October 2015 onward, when counted on 2026-09-22). A second pair, `sentinel-2-l2a` with `stats`, mirrors Earth Search's original index (51.25 million items when counted on 2026-09-15; its record starts in November 2016 and is partial before December 2018, which is what Earth Search serves). The imagery stays on AWS; every Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFF URL is carried verbatim in each item's `assets` column. This is a mirror; Earth Search / Element 84 produces the item indexes this catalog republishes. Read the [agent guide](AGENTS.md) before you query it.
